Great questions! Here's what our policies say:

**Overnight Shipping Speed**
Overnight shipping delivers on the **next business day**, as long as you place your order by **1 PM local time**. It's available for **$24.95**. (kb/02-shipping-policy.md)

**Choosing a Specific Arrival Date**

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!
